raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "give"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the spare keys"
  role recipient "Tomasz"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "pass to"
  role subject "Tomasz"
  role object "the spare keys"
  role recipient "the cleaning lady"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?w
  where match
    relation "have"
    role subject ?w
    role object "the keys"
    polarity affirmed
  end
